blocks.text: Select VoiceCom (SVC), a Philippine-based business process outsourcing (BPO) provider, officially announced its acquisition by The Office Gurus (TOG), the Contact Centers segment of Superior Group of Companies Inc. (NASDAQ: SGC), during a corporate gathering on November 3, 2026, at its office in Cebu IT Park, Cebu City. The acquisition expands TOG’s Philippine operations through SVC’s delivery centers in Cebu and Davao, creating opportunities for business expansion, stronger international connections, and employee development as both organizations enter a shared chapter of growth.
